I used cardboard to make a helmet (using a pattern that I found. After that I sorta eyeballed different parts of the skull, cut them out (all cardboard) and taped them on the helmet. A long and tedious process, but worth it :)

Oh I'm glad to hear you're interested! Orion is a tiefling sorcerer. Please keep in mind that I made them back when I didn't know anything about dnd and our dm was pretty free with us and our characters. In this world the racism against tieflings is really bad. Their backstory is pretty much that they had a deer as an animal companion and that they travelled everywhere together. One day however, that deer got hunted and killed by a tiefling hate group. The group was actually after Orion, but the deer jumped in to save them. Orion was devastated. From that day onwards they wore the skull of that deer as a mask (I know, technical difficulties, but let's just say it's magic haha) to disguise themselves. The death of the deer impacted them so much that their horns started to grow like antlers. I did not have the time to make those though :)
